industry: metal roofing, ceiling & wall cladding (residential + commercial)
location: Cairns / Portsmith, Far North Queensland (tropical AU)
personality: long-serving tropical-coast roofer, plain-spoken, trade-credible, 18+ years local, weather-resilient specialist (not luxury, not corporate)
logo_strategy: A&J initials rendered as roof-pitch geometry: 'A' is a literal steep roof gable with a teal ridge-cap notch at the apex, ampersand collapses to a single coral dot connector, 'J' carries the column-and-hook of a downpipe. Sans-serif workhorse wordmark below.
agent_prompt: Use the A&J roof-pitch monogram as drawn: the green gable with the teal ridge-cap notch is the brand signature — it must remain readable at favicon size. Brand reads as established tropical-coast roofer with 18+ years in Cairns & Far North QLD: practical, weather-resilient, trade-credible, plain-spoken. NOT luxury. NOT corporate. NOT design-studio minimalism. Use #1B5E3F (tropical roof green — derived from existing site's green CTA that the audit praised) as primary, #2A8C8C (Coral Sea teal — Cairns water/sky reference) as secondary, #D9744A (sun-bleached terracotta) as small accent only, and #F6F0E4 (sand/cream surface) as warm muted surface. DM Sans or Inter for headings and body — no slab serif (this is FNQ tropical, not regional-VIC heritage).

logo_assets.logo-light.svg: Full stacked lockup (A&J mark + A & J ROOFING + SOLUTIONS · CAIRNS FNQ) for light surfaces.
logo_assets.logo-dark.svg: Full lockup for dark surfaces (mark → white, ridge-cap → #5FD0C9 bright teal, coral dot → #F4A07A, wordmark → white).
logo_assets.logo-horizontal.svg: Inline lockup (mark left, wordmark right) for wide headers and email signatures.
logo_assets.logo-mark.svg: A&J monogram only · use for compact placements / favicon source / badge / mobile sticky header.
logo_assets.logo-wordmark.svg: A & J ROOFING + SOLUTIONS · CAIRNS FNQ wordmark only.
logo_assets.logo-mono-dark.svg: All-dark single color (teal ridge cap and coral dot collapse to single tone; gable geometry still reads).
logo_assets.favicon.svg: A&J mark padded to 1:1 · teal ridge-cap retained at favicon size.
logo_assets.social-avatar.svg: A&J mark on warm cream #F6F0E4 1024×1024 — natural circle/square crop for Google Business Profile.

clearspace: Reserve at least the A-gable base width (~170 SVG units / 1× cap-height) around the full lockup.
minimum_size: Full lockup: 160px wide minimum. Mark: 28px square. Favicon: 16px (A gable + J column remain; coral dot may disappear below 20px).
background_restrictions: Light variant on #FFFFFF, #F6F0E4, and pale sand stocks. Dark variant on surfaces darker than #1F2421. Do not place light logo on busy tropical photography (palm fronds, sky) without a 60% white scrim. Teal ridge-cap must reach 3:1 contrast against background.
small_size_assets: Use logo-mark.svg or favicon.svg for header <60px or compact UI.
logo_typography: Sans-serif workhorse (DM Sans 800 / 500 — open source, slightly warmer than Inter, good for tropical-trade voice). Wordmark uses live <text> elements at 92-104px primary, 42-48px subtitle.
heading_font: DM Sans 800 / 600 — geometric sans, warm but credible.
body_font: Inter 400/500 — clean sans, broad fallback support.
font_stack: 'DM Sans', 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif (for both headings and body)
header: Light header (#FFFFFF) with logo-horizontal.svg on desktop or logo-mark.svg on mobile. Phone number 07 4035 6187 top-right in brand-primary green as a tap-to-call button. Sticky on scroll. Proof chip strip below: '18+ years · Cairns & FNQ · Licensed (QBCC 1161095) · ABN verified'.
footer: Dark footer (#0F3D2A tropical-shade). logo-dark.svg + secondary text in #B8C5C0. Phone, email admin@anjroofing.com.au, address 98 Buchan St Portsmith QLD 4870, ABN 34 134 811 831, QBCC licence 1161095.
favicon_social: favicon.svg for tabs · social-avatar.svg (warm cream bg) for Google Business Profile.
buttons: Primary CTA: solid brand-primary #1B5E3F, white text, 4px corner radius (the existing site's green CTA was praised in audit — keep that cue). Secondary: outlined teal #2A8C8C border, teal text. Hover: 10% darker. Phone CTAs always primary green.
links: Inline links use brand-secondary #2A8C8C with underline. Hover deepens to #1F6E6E.
sections: Alternate white #FFFFFF and warm sand #F6F0E4 — the sand surface carries tropical-coast warmth without being a beach-resort cliché. One hero per page with real Cairns roof photography.
cards: Soft corners (6px). 1px #E1D9C7 border (warm sand border, matches surface). No drop shadows by default; subtle 4% shadow only on hover.
icons: Rounded line icons, 2px stroke. Tropical-roof cues: gable, downpipe, gutter, metal sheet, cyclone-tie strap, ladder. Avoid suns, palms, beach icons — that's resort, not roofer.
imagery: Real Cairns / Portsmith / FNQ roof photography: metal roofing on Queenslander houses, commercial cladding jobs, tropical-weather-resilient details, the team on-site. Avoid stock palm-tree beach shots and stock crew handshakes.
avoid: No corporate-trade gradient/icon-pack cliché. No 'EST. 2008' badges (founding year not verified — claim is '18+ years'). No condensed display fonts. No luxury palette (no gold, no navy-and-bronze). No beach-resort visual cues (no palm icons, no surf imagery, no aqua-gradient hero washes).
website_visual_style: Established tropical-coast roofer. Sans-serif warm-modern + sand surface + tropical green + Coral Sea teal accent. Trade-capable voice in copy. Photo-heavy with real Cairns roofs and the actual team. Not luxury, not SaaS, not 'modern minimal', not beach-resort.
design_loop_notes: See logo-review.md for 3-direction exploration (A-gable monogram / circular tropical-roof badge / signature wordmark), rejected directions, and the honest synthetic-origin disclosure.
limitations: Wordmark uses live <text> elements rendered via DM Sans font family. For print/PDF use, outline to paths first.
